parameters.query:
select
  c.customer_id,
  c.first_name,
  c.last_name,
  c.email,
  c.phone,
  c.preferred_contact_method,
  c.customer_since,
  c.account_type,
  c.account_status,
  c.created_at,
  c.updated_at
from public.customers c
where ($1::text <> '' and c.customer_id = $1::text)
   or ($2::text <> '' and lower(c.email) = lower($2::text))
order by case when c.customer_id = $1::text then 0 else 1 end
limit 1;

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ filterGroups: [{ filters: [{ propertyName: 'email', operator: 'EQ', value: $json.lookup_email }] }], properties: ['firstname','lastname','email','phone','customer_id','preferred_contact_method','customer_since','account_type'], limit: 2 }) }}
